articles.title: Forsling (upper body) a late scratch vs. Sharks
Barkov leaves in second period for Panthers following awkward fall
Ducks at Golden Knights projected lineups
PREVIEW: Ducks Begin Season with Playoff Rematch vs. Golden Knights

out.detail: Injured: lower body (placed on long-term injured reserve, will miss at least 10 games and 24 days)

away.summary: The Panthers (1-0-1) are dealing with significant injuries to key players Aleksander Barkov (lower body, LTIR), Jonah Gadjovich (neck), Brad Marchand (lower body), and Gustav Forsling (upper body, game-time decision). Forsling's status is uncertain as he is a game-time decision after being a late scratch versus the Sharks. The team will rely on Jacob Markstrom in goal and a projected lineup featuring Brady Tkachuk, Sam Reinhart, and Matthew Tkachuk on the top line.

home.summary: The Ducks (1-0-0) are missing defensemen Drew Helleson and Ian Moore (both lower body), forward Troy Terry (hip), and have scratched Nikita Klepov, Nick Jensen, and Frank Vatrano. Lukas Dostal is projected to start in goal. The team's projected lineup includes A.J. Greer, Leo Carlsson, and Cutter Gauthier on the top line, with rookie Judd Caulfield and Noah Warren in the mix.
